method: All positive XY extrusions except Custom. G2/G3 arcs subdivided with at most 0.02 mm chord error; bead radius = max(0.3 mm, maximum declared width / 2) + 0.02 mm. Convex hull distances give conservative lower bounds; sampled path distance is used when hulls cannot prove separation. XY projections include every layer, support and brim. Requires by-layer printing.
